versions.content: If a CanIf Controller mode state machine is either in state CAN_CS_STARTED , CAN_CS_STOPPED or CAN_CS_SLEEP when function CanIf_TT- SevereError() is called, then CanIf shall call the function CanSM_Controller- BusOff() for the CAN Network assigned to parameter Controller of CanIf_TT- SevereError() .

If a CanIf Controller mode state machine is either in state CAN_CS_STARTED , CAN_CS_STOPPED or CAN_CS_SLEEP when function CanIf_TT- SevereError() is called, then CanIf shall call the function CanSM_Controller- BusOff() for the CAN Network assigned to parameter Controller of CanIf_TT- SevereError() .

If a CanIf Controller mode state machine is either in state CAN_CS_STARTED , CAN_CS_STOPPED or CAN_CS_SLEEP when function CanIf_TT- SevereError() is called, then CanIf shall call the function CanSM_Controller- BusOff() for the CAN Network assigned to parameter Controller of CanIf_TT- SevereError() .
